hooks.name: Food-safety review
hooks.description: Reviews saves to the expiry, storage, product and recipe logic against the food-safety steering rules.

action.prompt: A food-safety file was just saved. Check the change against .kiro/steering/food-safety.md: high-risk categories, the no-pantry rule, isCookable, fail-closed diet filtering and the stage thresholds. If any rule got weaker, say so and suggest a fix. Also check that the tests in apps/api/test and the stage key still match.
